meta.title: RepoChan — Give the Repo a Soul
meta.description: RepoChan is a propaganda machine for creative production: scan the repo, raise a character, deliver the sheet, ship the page. The full brand kit, one pipeline.

call.note: Persona · foundation sheet · stickers · posters · landing page. One pipeline, the full brand kit.

analysis.note: Source, README, commit history. Deterministic scans first — the machine reads facts, it does not guess.

persona.note: Analysis plus interview raises a mascot: a world, a personality, visual anchors.

foundation.note: The foundation sheet ships first. Every downstream order references it — consistency is a dependency, not a prayer.

painter.note: Every asset is an order: brief, template, acceptance, versions. Delivered and archived — history is never dropped.

product.note: This very page is dogfood from the same pipeline. Below: real order evidence, not a decorative gallery.
